note: Both sets extract data from the Wiring Schedule table accurately but miss the 'Notes' section and diagram labels entirely. Set B is preferred because it maintains consistent entity naming for each component (e.g., always 'Wiring Schedule Item 34'), whereas Set A inconsistently switches between 'Wiring 34' and 'Wiring Schedule Item 34' for the same item. Both sets invent 'AWG' where not explicitly stated, but Set A's structural inconsistency is a more significant data quality issue.
remarks: Both sets fail to extract claims from the 'NOTES' section (Main Panel specs) and the diagram text (To Organizer panels), which are present in the text layer. Set A's entity inconsistency (mixing 'Wiring' and 'Wiring Schedule Item' for the same symbols) creates duplicate entities.
